expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every negative change value uses U+2212 MINUS SIGN, never U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS
expectations.evidence: Probe (Playwright 1.64 Chromium, 1280px, after document.fonts.ready, served over http): Change cells render "−1.7%", "−1.3 pp", "−1", "+0.5 pp"; every negative starts with U+2212 (MINUS constant replaces Intl minusSign parts); no U+002D in any Change cell; no hidden text in the cells.

expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every percentage-point change keeps its number and unit together with U+00A0 or U+202F (no plain U+0020 between the number and pp or percentage points)
expectations.evidence: Both pp cells: the only code point between the number and "pp" is U+00A0 ("−1.3 pp", "+0.5 pp", from `fracSpan.append(NBSP, abbr)`); no U+0020.

expectations.text: The numeric cells (Q1, Q2, Q3 and Change) render with tabular lining figures: their computed font-variant-numeric includes neither oldstyle-nums nor proportional-nums
expectations.evidence: Every numeric td and its text-bearing spans (.int, .frac, abbr) compute font-variant-numeric "lining-nums tabular-nums" (from `table { font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; }`).

expectations.text: The numeric cells and the header cells above them are aligned to the end of their column (computed text-align end or right)
expectations.evidence: All Q1-Q3 and Change td (display table-cell) and their thead th compute text-align "end" (`.numeric { text-align: end; }` on both); decimal alignment is done with inline-block .frac slots inside the end-aligned cell.

expectations.text: An @font-face rule loads fonts/SourceSerif4[opsz,wght].ttf and Chromium renders the numeric cells in Source Serif 4 (not a fallback face)
expectations.evidence: @font-face src `url("fonts/SourceSerif4%5Bopsz,wght%5D.ttf") format("truetype")`, FontFace status loaded; CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode on every tbody td and descendant reports only "Source Serif 4" (SourceSerif4Roman-Regular_wght_opsz100000, isCustomFont true, 162 glyphs).

expectations.text: Column headers are th elements with scope="col" and each row's metric is a th with scope="row"
expectations.evidence: thead: Metric, Q1, Q2, Q3, Change are th scope="col"; tbody: Revenue (EUR), Operating margin, Headcount, Churn are th scope="row".
